scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Sewing Machine (CBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be working in an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and have regular contributions received by the Board
Assistance is only for the spouse of a registered male construction worker or a female construction worker (once in a lifetime)
Applicant must be a member of the Board for at least 6 months before applying
Application must be submitted within one year of eligibility
Original purchase bill must be presented and verified by the employer
benefits_summary: A one‑time financial assistance of ₹3500 is provided to the spouse for purchasing a sewing machine.
documents_required: Clear picture of both sides of Aadhaar Card
Clear pictures of all pages of the BOCW copy issued by the Board
All mandatory annexures as required by the application process
